create_migration_live_write.detail: A real create_migration write finalized successfully on Studionet. Explorer showed FINALIZED, Accepted consensus, GenVM SUCCESS, result code Return, and create_migration returned migration 5. The old frontend incorrectly displayed EXECUTION FAILURE because txExecutionResultName was absent.

add_route_live_write.transaction_hash: transaction hash observed manually but not yet recorded in repository evidence
add_route_live_write.detail: A subsequent real add_route write also finalized successfully on Studionet. The same pre-fix frontend transaction-result interpretation path could report a false execution failure.

transaction_result_normalization_bug.old_frontend_message: EXECUTION FAILURE — GenLayer transaction finalized without a successful execution result: UNKNOWN
transaction_result_normalization_bug.root_cause: On Studionet Studio, genlayer-js 1.1.8 can expose finalized execution success in consensus_data.leader_receipt.execution_result while txExecutionResultName is absent. The old frontend treated the missing normalized field as a proven execution failure.
transaction_result_normalization_bug.fix_detail: The frontend now normalizes FINISHED_WITH_RETURN/FINISHED_WITH_ERROR and Studio leader receipt SUCCESS/ERROR separately, and reports genuinely missing execution evidence as unavailable rather than contract failure.
transaction_result_normalization_bug.post_fix_live_confirmation: After Vercel deployed the fix commit, another real Studionet frontend write finalized successfully and the production UI displayed EXECUTION SUCCESS and 'Finalized successfully; contract state re-read from LATEST_FINAL.'.
